verdict.rationale: Runway's own docs list "Music, voice & sound effects generation" in its plans and describe generating and editing video, images and audio in one workspace, so creators can make audio in the same tool as their video. Nothing shows that the audio is generated to match a specific scene or video clip, and the feature is documented only as a short line item. Missing for 10: scene-aware or video-to-audio generation, ambient audio specifically, in-depth feature docs, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
